summary: Verified FlixIT player-stability bug fix and watch-progress threshold change. All specified scenarios passed on public preview URL: iframe src / DOM node / window.history / page URL remained stable for 35+ seconds after mount for card-play, hero-play, and logged-in resume flows. In-app back-button returns to /browse. Browser go_back returns to /browse in a single call, confirming no history pollution. Watch-progress backend threshold now 10s (progress=5 -> skipped, progress=12 -> saved). Continue watching row renders and backend persists item with progress > 10.
critical_code_review_comments: WatchPage.tsx: startAt persisted via useState + resolved once via effect before iframe mounts; useMemo on [id,type,season,episode,startAt] with key=url on iframe correctly prevents re-mount. Good fix.

handleGoBack uses history.length delta (extra = history.length - historyLenAtMount). Works but note history.length includes forward-history too; if user navigated forward before entering /watch this could over-estimate. Not observed in tests. Consider tracking a listener on 'popstate' or using a routed history stack for a more robust solution.
Backend threshold literal 10 duplicated in two places (frontend MIN_WATCH_SECONDS + backend). Consider centralising as env/config to avoid drift.
